scope: Independent code/receipt audit of S81/S82 consumer semantics, preflight-only executor, and synthetic Stage-4 qualification. Real Phase-B binaries were not available in this ChatGPT runtime, so artifact-level recomputation was not independently re-executed here.
accepted_or_supported: S81 is materially addressed by a dedicated artifact-level consumer-semantics verifier rather than JSON self-consistency checks.

Claude's own mutation suite found S82: systematic dictionary reordering across all shards escaped cross-shard agreement; C16 construction-order and C17 dictionary content digests were added to close that class.
The committed executor exposes only --preflight-only at CLI level and refuses un-authorized real execution.
The source contains an AST-based no-raw-matrix access audit rather than a self-defeating string grep.

findings.title: G16 executor Git custody is not yet complete in the preflight receipt
findings.evidence: At audited head 9f20a6f, scripts/v64/stage4_executor_v1.py is committed with Git blob 01ce652cef8da70870489d74bb7763c3062521dc, but V64_STAGE4_PREFLIGHT_ONLY_RECEIPT_V1.json records worktree_blob=01ce652... and git_blob_at_head=null.
findings.consequence: The receipt does not yet prove stored/committed executor identity at the audited head, even though the file is now committed.
findings.required_repair: Regenerate a post-commit executor identity receipt binding exact executor SHA-256, exact Git blob, source commit, authority SHA/blob, and worktree equality. The receipt itself must then be committed and re-audited.

findings.title: The real Stage-4 execution path is not implemented yet
findings.evidence: In stage4_executor_v1.py, if authorization is present and valid, main() raises Stop('authorised real execution is not implemented in this build').
findings.consequence: The current artifact is a hardened preflight + frozen math library, not yet the complete real executor requested for the eventual one-shot Stage-4 run.
findings.required_repair: Implement the real execution path behind the existing exact authorization gate, using only frozen Phase-B inputs and frozen methods. Do not execute it. Synthetic tests must exercise the same real execution orchestration using synthetic fixtures or an injected in-memory test adapter without exposing a CLI bypass.

findings.title: Stage-4 cannot by itself exclude an unmeasured within-donor cross-modal technical factor
findings.evidence: Claude's planted metacell-varying hidden technical driver produced Delta +0.6540 versus +0.7854 for the planted biological positive, while control-vs-control remained +0.0000.
findings.consequence: A positive real Stage-4 result is evidence of correspondence under the measured nuisance basis and matched-control design, but is not sufficient proof that the signal is biological.
findings.required_interpretation: Do not tune the frozen Stage-4 gate to remove this synthetic failure after seeing it. Preserve the limitation prospectively. Any biological teacher-state use must require triangulation with evidence that has different failure modes (e.g. external regulatory architecture, separate-nucleus replication, perturbation, spatial where qualified) and/or a directly measured proxy for the implicated technical class.
